rules.quote: axil_regfile is a bank of PARA_NUM_REGS 32-bit read/write control registers and one 32-bit read-only status register.
rules.statement: The block provides PARA_NUM_REGS 32-bit read/write control registers and one 32-bit read-only status register.

rules.quote: A CPU reads and writes them through an AXI4-Lite subordinate port. AXI4-Lite subordinate port with a 32-bit data bus and a PARA_ADDR_W-bit address bus (7 to 16 bits).
rules.statement: The registers are accessed through an AXI4-Lite subordinate port with a 32-bit data bus and a PARA_ADDR_W-bit address bus.

rules.quote: The current value of every read/write register drives the SoC logic directly on o_regs.
rules.statement: The current value of every read/write register drives o_regs directly.

rules.quote: A read of the status register returns the SoC status word i_status. A read-only status register at byte address 0x40.
rules.statement: A read of the status register at byte address 0x40 returns the SoC status word i_status.

rules.quote: 1 to 16 read/write registers at byte addresses 0x00 + 4k.
rules.statement: The block implements 1 to 16 read/write registers at byte addresses 0x00 + 4k.

rules.quote: Each one resets to 0.
rules.statement: Each read/write register resets to 0.

rules.quote: Byte-lane writes controlled by i_s_axi_wstrb.
rules.condition: On a write to a read/write register
rules.statement: Byte-lane writes are controlled by i_s_axi_wstrb.

rules.quote: It returns i_status as sampled when the read address is taken.
rules.statement: The status read returns i_status as sampled when the read address is taken.

rules.quote: An access to an unmapped address answers SLVERR.
rules.statement: An access to an unmapped address answers SLVERR.

rules.quote: An unmapped read returns 0.
rules.statement: An unmapped read returns 0.

rules.quote: The write address and the write data can arrive in either order or at the same edge.
rules.statement: The write address and the write data may arrive in either order or at the same edge, and the block must accept all.

rules.quote: The read path and the write path work independently, so a read and a write can be in progress at the same time.
rules.statement: A read and a write may be in progress at the same time, as the read and write paths work independently.

rules.quote: Fixed latency: one cycle from the last write handshake to the write response, and one cycle from the read address handshake to the read data.
rules.statement: The write response comes one cycle after the last write handshake, and the read data one cycle after the read address handshake.

rules.quote: Every output is registered, so no combinational path runs from an input to an output.
rules.statement: Every output is registered, with no combinational path from any input to any output.

rules.quote: One clock, and one active-low reset with asynchronous assertion.
rules.statement: The block uses one clock and one active-low reset with asynchronous assertion.

rules.quote: The response codes EXOKAY (2'b01) and DECERR (2'b11). The block never produces them.
rules.statement: The block never produces response codes EXOKAY (2'b01) or DECERR (2'b11).

rules.quote: Protection checking. i_s_axi_awprot and i_s_axi_arprot are ignored.
rules.statement: i_s_axi_awprot and i_s_axi_arprot are ignored.

rules.quote: Address bits [1:0] are ignored and there is no unaligned-access error.
rules.statement: Address bits [1:0] are ignored and no unaligned-access error is produced.

rules.quote: Term: Transfer (handshake); Meaning: A rising edge of i_clk at which the valid and the ready of a channel are both 1 and i_rst_n is 1. The channel's payload is taken at that edge.
rules.condition: A channel's valid and ready are both 1 at a rising edge of i_clk with i_rst_n 1
rules.statement: A transfer occurs at a rising edge of i_clk when valid and ready of a channel are both 1 and i_rst_n is 1; the payload is taken at that edge.

rules.quote: Term: Edge n / cycle n; Meaning: Edge n is the n-th rising edge of i_clk. Cycle n is the clock period between edge n-1 and edge n: it starts at edge n-1 and ends at edge n. "From edge n" means "starting in cycle n+1": the value holds from that cycle until another requirement changes it (for example a "shall be 0 from edge" requirement, a held state ending, or a reset).
rules.condition: A requirement says a value holds 'from edge n'
rules.statement: A value required 'from edge n' holds starting in cycle n+1 until another requirement changes it, such as a held state ending or a reset.

rules.quote: Term: Held write address; Meaning: In cycle n, a write address is held if its AW transfer happened at an edge e <= n-1 and the B transfer of its transaction has not happened at any edge <= n-1, and i_rst_n has not been 0 since that AW transfer (a reset ends the held state, REQ-RST-009). Term: Held write data; Meaning: In cycle n, write data is held if its W transfer happened at an edge e <= n-1 and the B transfer of its transaction has not happened at any edge <= n-1, and i_rst_n has not been 0 since that W transfer (a reset ends the held state, REQ-RST-009). Term: Held read address; Meaning: In cycle n, a read address is held if its AR transfer happened at an edge e <= n-1 and the R transfer of its transaction has not happened at any edge <= n-1, and i_rst_n has not been 0 since that AR transfer (a reset ends the held state, REQ-RST-009).
rules.condition: Determining whether a write address, write data or read address is held
rules.statement: A write address, write data or read address is held in cycle n if its transfer occurred at an edge <= n-1, its B or R transfer has not occurred, and i_rst_n has not been 0 since; reset ends the held state.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_NUM_REGS; Default: 8; Legal values: 1 to 16; Description: Number of read/write registers
rules.statement: PARA_NUM_REGS sets the number of read/write registers, default 8, with legal values 1 to 16.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_ADDR_W; Default: 8; Legal values: 7 to 16; Description: Width in bits of i_s_axi_awaddr and i_s_axi_araddr; 7 is the minimum that reaches the status register at 0x40
rules.statement: PARA_ADDR_W sets the width in bits of i_s_axi_awaddr and i_s_axi_araddr, default 8, legal values 7 to 16.

rules.quote: Parameter: LPARA_REGS_W; Default: Derived; Legal values: -; Description: PARA_NUM_REGS*32 LPARA_REGS_W is the width of o_regs in bits: 32 with PARA_NUM_REGS = 1, 256 with the default, 512 with PARA_NUM_REGS = 16.
rules.statement: LPARA_REGS_W is derived as PARA_NUM_REGS*32 and is the width of o_regs in bits (32 for 1 register, 256 default, 512 for 16).

rules.quote: [REQ-PAR-001] The block shall behave as this specification states for every combination of PARA_NUM_REGS from 1 to 16 and PARA_ADDR_W from 7 to 16.
rules.condition: For every combination of PARA_NUM_REGS from 1 to 16 and PARA_ADDR_W from 7 to 16
rules.statement: The block must behave as the specification states for every legal combination of PARA_NUM_REGS (1 to 16) and PARA_ADDR_W (7 to 16).

rules.quote: [REQ-PAR-002] LPARA_REGS_W shall be a local parameter equal to PARA_NUM_REGS*32 that cannot be overridden from outside the module.
rules.statement: LPARA_REGS_W shall be a local parameter equal to PARA_NUM_REGS*32 that cannot be overridden from outside the module.

rules.quote: [REQ-PAR-003] The RTL should stop elaboration with an error message when PARA_NUM_REGS or PARA_ADDR_W is outside its legal range.
rules.condition: PARA_NUM_REGS or PARA_ADDR_W is outside its legal range
rules.statement: The RTL should stop elaboration with an error message when PARA_NUM_REGS or PARA_ADDR_W is outside its legal range.

rules.quote: [REQ-PAR-004] Behaviour with illegal parameter values is not specified and shall not be verified.
rules.statement: Behaviour with illegal parameter values is unspecified and must not be verified.

rules.quote: Port: i_s_axi_wdata; Direction: input; Width: 32; Signal type: Data; Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Write data; byte lane i is bits 8i+7..8i [REQ-IF-003] Byte lane i (i = 0 to 3) of a register shall be bits 8i+7..8i, shall correspond to i_s_axi_wdata[8i+7:8i] and o_s_axi_rdata[8i+7:8i], and shall be enabled by i_s_axi_wstrb[i].
rules.statement: Byte lane i of a register must be bits 8i+7..8i and correspond to i_s_axi_wdata[8i+7:8i] and o_s_axi_rdata[8i+7:8i].

rules.quote: Port: i_s_axi_wstrb; Direction: input; Width: 4; Signal type: Data; Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Write strobes; bit i enables byte lane i [REQ-IF-003] Byte lane i (i = 0 to 3) of a register shall be bits 8i+7..8i, shall correspond to i_s_axi_wdata[8i+7:8i] and o_s_axi_rdata[8i+7:8i], and shall be enabled by i_s_axi_wstrb[i].
rules.statement: Byte lane i of a register must be enabled by i_s_axi_wstrb[i].

rules.quote: Port: o_regs; Direction: output; Width: LPARA_REGS_W; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Current values of the read/write registers; register k is bits 32k+31..32k [REQ-IF-002] Bits 32k+31..32k of o_regs shall carry the current value of read/write register k, for every k from 0 to PARA_NUM_REGS-1.
rules.condition: for every k from 0 to PARA_NUM_REGS-1
rules.statement: Bits 32k+31..32k of o_regs must carry the current value of read/write register k.

rules.quote: [REQ-IF-001] Every output shall change value only at a rising edge of i_clk or when i_rst_n is asserted, so that no output depends combinationally on any input in the same cycle.
rules.statement: Every output must change value only at a rising edge of i_clk or when i_rst_n is asserted.

rules.quote: [REQ-IF-001] Every output shall change value only at a rising edge of i_clk or when i_rst_n is asserted, so that no output depends combinationally on any input in the same cycle.
rules.statement: No output may depend combinationally on any input in the same cycle.

rules.quote: [REQ-IF-004] The values of i_s_axi_awprot and i_s_axi_arprot shall have no effect on any output.
rules.statement: The values of i_s_axi_awprot and i_s_axi_arprot must have no effect on any output.

rules.quote: Every flip-flop of the block is clocked on the rising edge of i_clk. [REQ-CLK-001] Every flip-flop of the block shall be clocked by the rising edge of i_clk.
rules.statement: Every flip-flop of the block shall be clocked by the rising edge of i_clk.

rules.quote: Assertion is asynchronous. [REQ-RST-004] When i_rst_n goes from 1 to 0, every output shall take its reset value without waiting for a rising edge of i_clk.
rules.statement: Every output shall take its reset value asynchronously, without waiting for a rising edge of i_clk.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-001] While i_rst_n is 0, o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready, o_s_axi_arready, o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready, o_s_axi_arready, o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-002] While i_rst_n is 0, o_s_axi_bresp, o_s_axi_rresp and o_s_axi_rdata shall be 0.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bresp, o_s_axi_rresp and o_s_axi_rdata shall be 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-003] While i_rst_n is 0, every bit of o_regs shall be 0.
rules.statement: Every bit of o_regs shall be 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-005] No transfer shall happen on any channel at an edge where i_rst_n is 0, whatever the values of i_s_axi_awvalid, i_s_axi_wvalid, i_s_axi_arvalid, i_s_axi_bready and i_s_axi_rready.
rules.condition: At a clock edge where i_rst_n is 0
rules.statement: No transfer shall happen on any channel, whatever the values of the valid and ready inputs.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-006] No transfer shall happen on any channel at edge R1, because o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready are 0 in the cycle that ends at R1 and o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid are 0 in that cycle.
rules.condition: At edge R1, the first rising edge after reset release
rules.statement: No transfer shall happen on any channel at R1, because the ready outputs and bvalid/rvalid are 0 in the cycle ending at R1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-007] o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready shall be 1 from edge R1, that is, in the cycle that starts at R1.
rules.condition: From edge R1, in the cycle starting at R1
rules.statement: o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready shall be 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-008] o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid shall stay 0 after R1 until a write or read transaction makes them 1 as section 7 states.
rules.condition: After R1, until a write or read transaction makes them 1
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid shall stay 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-009] When i_rst_n is asserted while a write address, write data, write response or read address is held or pending, the held state shall be discarded.
rules.condition: When i_rst_n is asserted while a write address, write data, write response or read address is held or pending
rules.statement: The held state shall be discarded.

rules.quote: No B or R response shall be given for that transaction after release, and no register shall be written by it after release.
rules.condition: After release, for a transaction pending when reset was asserted
rules.statement: No B or R response shall be given for that transaction, and no register shall be written by it.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-010] A valid that the manager holds at 1 through reset and after R1 shall be treated as a new transfer request. It is taken at the first edge after R1 where the matching ready is 1, which is the edge after R1 at the earliest.
rules.condition: A valid held at 1 through reset and after R1
rules.statement: It shall be treated as a new transfer request, taken at the first edge after R1 where the matching ready is 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-DEC-001] Bits [1:0] of i_s_axi_awaddr and i_s_axi_araddr shall have no effect on any output.
rules.statement: Bits [1:0] of i_s_axi_awaddr and i_s_axi_araddr must have no effect on any output.

rules.quote: [REQ-DEC-002] An address whose word index is k, with 0 <= k < PARA_NUM_REGS, shall select read/write register k.
rules.condition: Address word index k with 0 <= k < PARA_NUM_REGS
rules.statement: An address with word index k selects read/write register k.

rules.quote: [REQ-DEC-003] An address whose word index is 16 (byte address 0x40 to 0x43) shall select the status register.
rules.condition: Address word index is 16 (byte address 0x40 to 0x43)
rules.statement: The address selects the status register.

rules.quote: [REQ-DEC-004] Every other address shall be unmapped. This includes word indices PARA_NUM_REGS to 15, word indices 17 to 31, and every address with a 1 in any bit from bit 7 to bit PARA_ADDR_W-1.
rules.condition: Address is not a read/write register or status register address, including word indices PARA_NUM_REGS to 15, 17 to 31, or any 1 in bit 7 to PARA_ADDR_W-1
rules.statement: Every other address is unmapped.

rules.quote: [REQ-DEC-005] The decode shall compare all bits [PARA_ADDR_W-1:2] of the address, so that no mapped register or status register appears at more than one word index (no aliasing).
rules.statement: Decode compares all address bits [PARA_ADDR_W-1:2] so no register or status register appears at more than one word index (no aliasing).

rules.quote: [REQ-DEC-006] A write transaction shall be decoded from the address taken at its AW transfer.
rules.statement: A write transaction is decoded from the address taken at its AW transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-DEC-007] A read transaction shall be decoded from the address taken at its AR transfer.
rules.statement: A read transaction is decoded from the address taken at its AR transfer.

rules.section_title: Write address and write data acceptance
rules.quote: [REQ-WR-001] In every cycle after R1 in which no write address is held, o_s_axi_awready shall be 1.
rules.condition: Every cycle after R1 in which no write address is held
rules.statement: o_s_axi_awready shall be 1.

rules.section_title: Write address and write data acceptance
rules.quote: [REQ-WR-002] In every cycle in which a write address is held, o_s_axi_awready shall be 0.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_awready shall be 0.

rules.section_title: Write address and write data acceptance
rules.quote: [REQ-WR-003] In every cycle after R1 in which no write data is held, o_s_axi_wready shall be 1.
rules.condition: Every cycle after R1 in which no write data is held
rules.statement: o_s_axi_wready shall be 1.

rules.section_title: Write address and write data acceptance
rules.quote: [REQ-WR-004] In every cycle in which write data is held, o_s_axi_wready shall be 0.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_wready shall be 0.

rules.section_title: Write address and write data acceptance
rules.quote: [REQ-WR-005] The block shall take the AW transfer and the W transfer of one transaction in either order or at the same edge, and shall not answer before it has taken both.
rules.statement: The block takes the AW and W transfers in either order or at the same edge.

rules.section_title: Write address and write data acceptance
rules.quote: [REQ-WR-005] The block shall take the AW transfer and the W transfer of one transaction in either order or at the same edge, and shall not answer before it has taken both.
rules.condition: Before both AW and W transfers of the transaction are taken
rules.statement: The block shall not answer a write transaction before it has taken both AW and W transfers.

rules.section_title: Write address and write data acceptance
rules.quote: [REQ-WR-006] After an AW transfer, the block shall take no other AW transfer until the edge after Eb of that transaction.
rules.condition: After an AW transfer, until the edge after Eb of that transaction
rules.statement: The block shall take no other AW transfer.

rules.section_title: Write address and write data acceptance
rules.quote: [REQ-WR-007] After a W transfer, the block shall take no other W transfer until the edge after Eb of that transaction.
rules.condition: After a W transfer, until the edge after Eb of that transaction
rules.statement: The block shall take no other W transfer.

rules.section_title: Write address and write data acceptance
rules.quote: [REQ-WR-008] The write strobes and write data used by a transaction shall be the values of i_s_axi_wstrb and i_s_axi_wdata taken at its W transfer.
rules.statement: The strobes and data used are the values of i_s_axi_wstrb and i_s_axi_wdata taken at the W transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-010] When a write transaction selects read/write register k, then at edge Ec, for each byte lane i with i_s_axi_wstrb[i] = 1 (as taken at Ew), bits 8i+7..8i of register k shall take the value of bits 8i+7..8i of the write data taken at Ew.
rules.condition: Write selects read/write register k, at edge Ec, for each lane i with i_s_axi_wstrb[i]=1
rules.statement: Bits 8i+7..8i of register k take the value of the same bits of the write data taken at Ew.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-011] When a write transaction selects read/write register k, the byte lanes of register k whose strobe bit is 0 shall keep their value.
rules.statement: Byte lanes of register k whose strobe bit is 0 keep their value.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-012] The value written at Ec shall appear on o_regs[32k+31:32k] from edge Ec, that is, in the cycle that starts at Ec.
rules.condition: Write to register k at edge Ec
rules.statement: The written value appears on o_regs[32k+31:32k] from edge Ec, in the cycle starting at Ec.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-013] A write transaction shall change no bit of o_regs outside bits 32k+31..32k of the register it selects.
rules.statement: A write shall change no bit of o_regs outside bits 32k+31..32k.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-014] A write transaction shall change its register only at its edge Ec and only once.
rules.statement: A write changes its register only at its edge Ec and only once.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-015] A write transaction that selects the status register shall change no bit of o_regs.
rules.statement: The write shall change no bit of o_regs.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-016] A write transaction to an unmapped address shall change no bit of o_regs.
rules.statement: The write shall change no bit of o_regs.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-017] A write transaction to read/write register k with i_s_axi_wstrb = 4'b0000 shall change no bit of o_regs and shall answer OKAY.
rules.condition: Write to read/write register k with i_s_axi_wstrb = 4'b0000
rules.statement: The write changes no bit of o_regs and answers OKAY.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-018] Bits of o_regs shall change only at edge Ec of a write transaction that selects them or when i_rst_n is asserted.
rules.condition: Other than edge Ec of a write selecting them or i_rst_n asserted
rules.statement: Bits of o_regs shall not change.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-020] o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 1 from edge Ec of a write transaction, that is, in the cycle that starts at Ec.
rules.condition: From edge Ec of a write transaction
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 1 in the cycle starting at Ec.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-021] Once o_s_axi_bvalid is 1, it shall stay 1 and o_s_axi_bresp shall stay unchanged until and including the cycle that ends at Eb.
rules.condition: Once o_s_axi_bvalid is 1, until and including the cycle ending at Eb
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bvalid stays 1 and o_s_axi_bresp stays unchanged.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-022] o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 0 from edge Eb, unless i_rst_n is asserted earlier.
rules.condition: From edge Eb, unless i_rst_n asserted earlier
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-023] The block shall give exactly one B transfer for each write transaction that reaches Ec, and o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 0 in every cycle in which no such transaction is waiting for its B transfer.
rules.condition: Each write transaction that reaches Ec
rules.statement: The block gives exactly one B transfer per write transaction.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-023] The block shall give exactly one B transfer for each write transaction that reaches Ec, and o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 0 in every cycle in which no such transaction is waiting for its B transfer.
rules.condition: No write transaction is waiting for its B transfer
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-024] o_s_axi_bresp shall be 2'b00 (OKAY) for a write transaction that selects a read/write register or the status register.
rules.condition: Write selects a read/write register or the status register
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bresp shall be 2'b00 (OKAY).

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-025] o_s_axi_bresp shall be 2'b10 (SLVERR) for a write transaction to an unmapped address.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bresp shall be 2'b10 (SLVERR).

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-026] o_s_axi_bresp shall never be 2'b01 or 2'b11 while o_s_axi_bvalid is 1.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bresp shall never be 2'b01 or 2'b11.

rules.quote: [REQ-WR-027] While o_s_axi_bvalid is 0 and i_rst_n is 1, the value of o_s_axi_bresp is not specified and shall not be checked.
rules.statement: The value of o_s_axi_bresp is unspecified and shall not be checked.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-001] In every cycle after R1 in which no read address is held, o_s_axi_arready shall be 1.
rules.condition: Every cycle after R1 in which no read address is held
rules.statement: o_s_axi_arready shall be 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-002] In every cycle in which a read address is held, o_s_axi_arready shall be 0.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_arready shall be 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-003] After an AR transfer, the block shall take no other AR transfer until the edge after Er of that transaction.
rules.condition: After an AR transfer, until the edge after Er of that transaction
rules.statement: The block shall take no other AR transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-004] o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 1 from edge Ear of a read transaction, that is, in the cycle that starts at Ear.
rules.condition: From edge Ear of a read transaction
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 1 in the cycle starting at Ear.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-005] Once o_s_axi_rvalid is 1, it shall stay 1 and o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp shall stay unchanged until and including the cycle that ends at Er.
rules.condition: Once o_s_axi_rvalid is 1, until and including the cycle ending at Er
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rvalid stays 1 and o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp stay unchanged.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-006] o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0 from edge Er, unless i_rst_n is asserted earlier.
rules.condition: From edge Er, unless i_rst_n asserted earlier
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-007] The block shall give exactly one R transfer for each AR transfer, and o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0 in every cycle in which no read transaction is waiting for its R transfer.
rules.statement: The block gives exactly one R transfer for each AR transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-007] The block shall give exactly one R transfer for each AR transfer, and o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0 in every cycle in which no read transaction is waiting for its R transfer.
rules.condition: No read transaction is waiting for its R transfer
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-008] For a read transaction that selects read/write register k, o_s_axi_rdata shall equal the value of o_regs[32k+31:32k] in the cycle that ends at Ear.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rdata equals o_regs[32k+31:32k] in the cycle ending at Ear.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-009] For a read transaction that selects the status register, o_s_axi_rdata shall equal the value of i_status in the cycle that ends at Ear.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rdata equals i_status in the cycle ending at Ear.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-010] A change of i_status after Ear shall not change o_s_axi_rdata of the read transaction in progress.
rules.condition: i_status changes after Ear during the read in progress
rules.statement: The change shall not alter o_s_axi_rdata.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-011] o_s_axi_rresp shall be 2'b00 (OKAY) for a read transaction that selects a read/write register or the status register.
rules.condition: Read selects a read/write register or the status register
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rresp shall be 2'b00 (OKAY).

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-012] For a read transaction to an unmapped address, o_s_axi_rdata shall be 32'h0000_0000 and o_s_axi_rresp shall be 2'b10 (SLVERR).
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rdata shall be 32'h0000_0000 and o_s_axi_rresp shall be 2'b10 (SLVERR).

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-013] o_s_axi_rresp shall never be 2'b01 or 2'b11 while o_s_axi_rvalid is 1.
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rresp shall never be 2'b01 or 2'b11.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-014] While o_s_axi_rvalid is 0 and i_rst_n is 1, the values of o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp are not specified and shall not be checked.
rules.statement: Values of o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp are unspecified and shall not be checked.

rules.quote: [REQ-RD-015] A read transaction shall change no bit of o_regs.
rules.statement: A read shall change no bit of o_regs.

rules.quote: [REQ-CC-001] The AR and R channels shall work independently of the AW, W and B channels. Whether a write is held or waiting for its B transfer shall not change the value or timing of o_s_axi_arready, o_s_axi_rvalid, o_s_axi_rdata or o_s_axi_rresp, except for the register value returned as stated in REQ-CC-003 to REQ-CC-006.
rules.condition: A write is held or waiting for its B transfer
rules.statement: AR and R channels work independently of AW, W and B: value and timing of arready, rvalid, rdata, rresp are unchanged, except register value per REQ-CC-003 to 006.

rules.quote: [REQ-CC-002] Whether a read is held or waiting for its R transfer shall not change the value or timing of o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready, o_s_axi_bvalid, o_s_axi_bresp or o_regs.
rules.condition: A read is held or waiting for its R transfer
rules.statement: The value and timing of awready, wready, bvalid, bresp and o_regs shall not change.

rules.quote: [REQ-CC-003] When the AR transfer of a read of register k happens at the same edge as Ec of a write to register k, the read shall return the value of register k before that write (the old value).
rules.condition: AR transfer of a read of register k at the same edge as Ec of a write to register k
rules.statement: The read returns the old value of register k before that write.

rules.quote: [REQ-CC-004] When Ec of a write to register k is before Ear of a read of register k, the read shall return the value written by that write, unless another write to register k with an Ec before Ear came in between.
rules.condition: Ec of a write to register k is before Ear of a read of register k
rules.statement: The read returns the value written, unless another write to k with Ec before Ear came in between.

rules.quote: [REQ-CC-005] When Ec of a write to register k is after Ear of a read of register k, that write shall not change o_s_axi_rdata of the read.
rules.condition: Ec of a write to register k is after Ear of a read of register k
rules.statement: The write shall not change o_s_axi_rdata of the read.

rules.quote: [REQ-CC-006] The read data of register k shall always equal one whole value that register k held in the cycle that ends at Ear, and never a mix of the bytes of two values.
rules.statement: Read data equals one whole value register k held in the cycle ending at Ear, never a mix of bytes of two values.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-001] When the manager drives i_s_axi_awvalid, i_s_axi_wvalid and i_s_axi_bready at 1 continuously, the block shall complete one write transaction every 2 cycles, with the AW and W transfers at edge n, the B transfer at edge n+1, and the next AW and W transfers at edge n+2.
rules.condition: manager drives i_s_axi_awvalid, i_s_axi_wvalid and i_s_axi_bready at 1 continuously
rules.statement: The block completes one write transaction every 2 cycles: AW and W transfers at edge n, B transfer at edge n+1, next AW and W at edge n+2.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-002] When the manager drives i_s_axi_arvalid and i_s_axi_rready at 1 continuously, the block shall complete one read transaction every 2 cycles, with the AR transfer at edge n, the R transfer at edge n+1, and the next AR transfer at edge n+2.
rules.condition: manager drives i_s_axi_arvalid and i_s_axi_rready at 1 continuously
rules.statement: The block completes one read transaction every 2 cycles: AR transfer at edge n, R transfer at edge n+1, next AR at edge n+2.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-003] Readies of the block shall not wait for the matching valid. o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready shall be 1 whenever REQ-WR-001, REQ-WR-003 and REQ-RD-001 say so, whatever the values of the valids.
rules.statement: The block's readies must not wait for the matching valid; o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready are 1 as REQ-WR-001, REQ-WR-003 and REQ-RD-001 say, regardless of the valids.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-010] While i_s_axi_bready is 0 and o_s_axi_bvalid is 1, the block shall keep the response pending and shall take no new AW or W transfer, for any number of cycles.
rules.statement: The block keeps the write response pending for any number of cycles while i_s_axi_bready is 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-010] While i_s_axi_bready is 0 and o_s_axi_bvalid is 1, the block shall keep the response pending and shall take no new AW or W transfer, for any number of cycles.
rules.statement: The block takes no new AW or W transfer while the B response is pending and i_s_axi_bready is 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-011] While i_s_axi_rready is 0 and o_s_axi_rvalid is 1, the block shall keep the read data pending and shall take no new AR transfer, for any number of cycles.
rules.statement: The block keeps the read data pending for any number of cycles while i_s_axi_rready is 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-011] While i_s_axi_rready is 0 and o_s_axi_rvalid is 1, the block shall keep the read data pending and shall take no new AR transfer, for any number of cycles.
rules.statement: The block takes no new AR transfer while read data is pending and i_s_axi_rready is 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-012] Back-pressure on the B channel shall not stall the AR or R channel, and back-pressure on the R channel shall not stall the AW, W or B channel.
rules.statement: Back-pressure on the B channel must not stall the AR or R channel.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-012] Back-pressure on the B channel shall not stall the AR or R channel, and back-pressure on the R channel shall not stall the AW, W or B channel.
rules.statement: Back-pressure on the R channel must not stall the AW, W or B channel.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-013] Because only one write and one read can be in progress, the block shall answer write transactions in the order of their Ec and read transactions in the order of their Ear.
rules.statement: The block answers write transactions in the order of their Ec and read transactions in the order of their Ear.

rules.quote: Cycle: 5; awvalid: 0; awready: 1; awaddr: -; wvalid: 0; wready: 1; wdata: -; wstrb: -; bvalid: 0; bready: -; bresp: -; o_regs[63:32]: 0x0000_1234; Event at the end edge: Idle; new write can be taken
rules.condition: idle after the B transfer, with o_s_axi_bvalid 0
rules.statement: In the idle cycle after the B transfer, o_s_axi_awready and o_s_axi_wready are 1 so a new write can be taken.

rules.quote: Offset: 0x00 + 4k, k = 0 to PARA_NUM_REGS-1; Name: REG_k; Field: VALUE; Bits: 31:0; Access: RW; Reset: 0x0000_0000; Description: Control value k. Drives o_regs[32k+31:32k]. Byte lanes are written under i_s_axi_wstrb. Reads return the current value with OKAY.
rules.condition: Register REG_k at offset 0x00+4k, k=0..PARA_NUM_REGS-1, is reset
rules.statement: REG_k VALUE (bits 31:0, RW) shall reset to 0x0000_0000, so o_regs[32k+31:32k] is 0 after reset.

rules.quote: Offset: 0x00 + 4k, k = 0 to PARA_NUM_REGS-1; Name: REG_k; Field: VALUE; Bits: 31:0; Access: RW; Reset: 0x0000_0000; Description: Control value k. Drives o_regs[32k+31:32k]. Byte lanes are written under i_s_axi_wstrb. Reads return the current value with OKAY.
rules.condition: For each k from 0 to PARA_NUM_REGS-1
rules.statement: o_regs[32k+31:32k] shall be driven by the current value of REG_k.

rules.quote: Offset: 0x00 + 4k, k = 0 to PARA_NUM_REGS-1; Name: REG_k; Field: VALUE; Bits: 31:0; Access: RW; Reset: 0x0000_0000; Description: Control value k. Drives o_regs[32k+31:32k]. Byte lanes are written under i_s_axi_wstrb. Reads return the current value with OKAY. Access codes: RW is readable and writable.
rules.statement: Each byte lane of REG_k shall be written only when the corresponding i_s_axi_wstrb bit is set; other byte lanes shall keep their value.

rules.quote: Offset: 0x00 + 4k, k = 0 to PARA_NUM_REGS-1; Name: REG_k; Field: VALUE; Bits: 31:0; Access: RW; Reset: 0x0000_0000; Description: Control value k. Drives o_regs[32k+31:32k]. Byte lanes are written under i_s_axi_wstrb. Reads return the current value with OKAY. Access codes: RW is readable and writable.
rules.statement: A read of REG_k shall return the current register value with OKAY response.

rules.quote: Offset: 0x40; Name: STATUS; Field: VALUE; Bits: 31:0; Access: RO; Reset: Not applicable; Description: Read returns i_status sampled at Ear, with OKAY. A write changes nothing and answers OKAY.
rules.condition: A read of STATUS at offset 0x40
rules.statement: A read of STATUS shall return i_status sampled at Ear, with OKAY response.

rules.quote: Offset: 0x40; Name: STATUS; Field: VALUE; Bits: 31:0; Access: RO; Reset: Not applicable; Description: Read returns i_status sampled at Ear, with OKAY. A write changes nothing and answers OKAY. RO is read-only; a write is ignored and answers OKAY.
rules.condition: A write to STATUS at offset 0x40
rules.statement: A write to STATUS shall change nothing and answer OKAY.

rules.quote: Offset: 4*PARA_NUM_REGS to 0x3C; Name: Reserved; Field: -; Bits: 31:0; Access: -; Reset: -; Description: Unmapped; does not exist when PARA_NUM_REGS = 16. Read returns 0 with SLVERR. A write changes nothing and answers SLVERR.
rules.condition: A read from an address from 4*PARA_NUM_REGS to 0x3C (unmapped)
rules.statement: A read of the unmapped region below STATUS shall return 0 with SLVERR.

rules.quote: Offset: 4*PARA_NUM_REGS to 0x3C; Name: Reserved; Field: -; Bits: 31:0; Access: -; Reset: -; Description: Unmapped; does not exist when PARA_NUM_REGS = 16. Read returns 0 with SLVERR. A write changes nothing and answers SLVERR.
rules.condition: A write to an address from 4*PARA_NUM_REGS to 0x3C (unmapped)
rules.statement: A write to the unmapped region below STATUS shall change nothing and answer SLVERR.

rules.quote: Offset: 4*PARA_NUM_REGS to 0x3C; Name: Reserved; Field: -; Bits: 31:0; Access: -; Reset: -; Description: Unmapped; does not exist when PARA_NUM_REGS = 16. Read returns 0 with SLVERR. A write changes nothing and answers SLVERR.
rules.statement: The reserved region from 4*PARA_NUM_REGS to 0x3C shall not exist when PARA_NUM_REGS is 16.

rules.quote: Offset: 0x44 to 2^PARA_ADDR_W - 4; Name: Reserved; Field: -; Bits: 31:0; Access: -; Reset: -; Description: Unmapped. Read returns 0 with SLVERR. A write changes nothing and answers SLVERR.
rules.condition: A read from an address from 0x44 to 2^PARA_ADDR_W - 4
rules.statement: A read of the unmapped region above STATUS shall return 0 with SLVERR.

rules.quote: Offset: 0x44 to 2^PARA_ADDR_W - 4; Name: Reserved; Field: -; Bits: 31:0; Access: -; Reset: -; Description: Unmapped. Read returns 0 with SLVERR. A write changes nothing and answers SLVERR.
rules.condition: A write to an address from 0x44 to 2^PARA_ADDR_W - 4
rules.statement: A write to the unmapped region above STATUS shall change nothing and answer SLVERR.

rules.quote: Offsets are byte addresses with bits [1:0] ignored.
rules.statement: Address bits [1:0] shall be ignored when decoding register offsets.

rules.quote: For the default configuration (PARA_NUM_REGS = 8, PARA_ADDR_W = 8): REG_0 to REG_7 are at 0x00 to 0x1C, 0x20 to 0x3C is unmapped, STATUS is at 0x40, and 0x44 to 0xFC is unmapped. [REQ-REG-001] The register map shall be exactly the table above for every legal parameter combination.
rules.statement: The register map shall match the table exactly for every legal PARA_NUM_REGS and PARA_ADDR_W combination.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-001] A write to an unmapped address shall be detected by the decode of the address taken at Ea, shall change no register, and shall answer o_s_axi_bresp = 2'b10 (SLVERR) with the normal write timing.
rules.statement: A write to an unmapped address, detected by decoding the address taken at Ea, must change no register and answer o_s_axi_bresp = 2'b10 (SLVERR) with normal write timing.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-002] A read from an unmapped address shall be detected by the decode of the address taken at Ear, and shall return o_s_axi_rdata = 0 and o_s_axi_rresp = 2'b10 (SLVERR) with the normal read timing.
rules.statement: A read from an unmapped address, detected by decoding the address taken at Ear, must return o_s_axi_rdata = 0 and o_s_axi_rresp = 2'b10 (SLVERR) with normal read timing.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-003] A write to the status register shall change no register, shall have no effect on later reads of the status register other than through i_status, and shall answer OKAY. This holds for every value of i_s_axi_wstrb.
rules.condition: write to the status register, any value of i_s_axi_wstrb
rules.statement: A write to the status register must change no register, not affect later status reads other than through i_status, and answer OKAY, for every i_s_axi_wstrb value.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-004] A write with i_s_axi_wstrb = 4'b0000 shall answer exactly as a write with strobes to the same address (OKAY for a register or status, SLVERR for unmapped) and shall change no register.
rules.statement: A write with i_s_axi_wstrb = 4'b0000 must answer as a write with strobes to the same address (OKAY for register or status, SLVERR for unmapped) and change no register.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-005] An address with bits [1:0] not equal to 2'b00 shall not be an error.
rules.statement: An address with bits [1:0] not equal to 2'b00 must not be treated as an error.

rules.quote: It shall access the aligned word given by its word index.
rules.statement: An access with unaligned address bits [1:0] must access the aligned word given by its word index.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-006] Any value of i_s_axi_awprot or i_s_axi_arprot shall be accepted without an error and without an effect.
rules.condition: any value of awprot or arprot
rules.statement: Any value of i_s_axi_awprot or i_s_axi_arprot must be accepted without error and without effect.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-007] An unmapped access shall not stall or change the state of the other channels.
rules.statement: An unmapped access must not stall or change the state of the other channels.

rules.quote: The next transaction shall behave as if the unmapped access had targeted a mapped address.
rules.statement: The next transaction must behave as if the unmapped access had targeted a mapped address.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-008] A valid input at 1 while i_rst_n is 0 shall have no effect (REQ-RST-005).
rules.condition: a valid input is 1 while i_rst_n is 0
rules.statement: A valid input at 1 while i_rst_n is 0 must have no effect (REQ-RST-005).

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-009] Reset asserted in the middle of a transaction shall follow REQ-RST-004 and REQ-RST-009.
rules.condition: reset asserted in the middle of a transaction
rules.statement: Reset asserted mid-transaction must follow REQ-RST-004 and REQ-RST-009.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-010] If the manager breaks the handshake rules of section 12.1 (drops a valid or changes a payload before the transfer), the behaviour of the block is not specified and shall not be verified. The block need not detect it.
rules.condition: manager breaks handshake rules of section 12.1 (drops a valid or changes a payload before the transfer)
rules.statement: Block behaviour under manager handshake violations is unspecified and must not be verified; the block need not detect it.

rules.quote: [REQ-EXT-001] With PARA_NUM_REGS = 1, only byte address 0x00 (REG_0) and 0x40 (STATUS) shall be mapped, o_regs shall be 32 bits wide, and 0x04 to 0x3C shall be unmapped.
rules.statement: Only 0x00 (REG_0) and 0x40 (STATUS) are mapped, o_regs is 32 bits wide, and 0x04 to 0x3C are unmapped.

rules.quote: [REQ-EXT-002] With PARA_NUM_REGS = 16, byte addresses 0x00 to 0x3C shall be REG_0 to REG_15, 0x40 shall be STATUS, o_regs shall be 512 bits wide, and no address below 0x44 shall be unmapped.
rules.statement: 0x00 to 0x3C are REG_0 to REG_15, 0x40 is STATUS, o_regs is 512 bits wide, and no address below 0x44 is unmapped.

rules.quote: [REQ-EXT-003] With PARA_ADDR_W = 7, the address space shall be 0x00 to 0x7F and the addresses 0x44 to 0x7C shall be unmapped.
rules.statement: The address space is 0x00 to 0x7F and addresses 0x44 to 0x7C are unmapped.

rules.quote: [REQ-EXT-004] With PARA_ADDR_W = 16, every address with a 1 in any bit from 15 to 7 (for example 0x0080, 0x0100, 0x8040, 0xFFFC) shall be unmapped.
rules.statement: Every address with a 1 in any bit from 15 to 7 (e.g. 0x0080, 0x0100, 0x8040, 0xFFFC) is unmapped.

rules.quote: [REQ-EXT-005] The latency, throughput, reset and back-pressure behaviour shall be the same for every legal parameter combination.
rules.statement: Latency, throughput, reset and back-pressure behaviour must be the same for every legal parameter combination.

rules.quote: ID: CFG-BASE; Parameter values: PARA_NUM_REGS=8, PARA_ADDR_W=8; Purpose: Main configuration (defaults); covers the gap of unmapped addresses 0x20 to 0x3C
rules.statement: CFG-BASE uses PARA_NUM_REGS=8 and PARA_ADDR_W=8 as default and must cover the gap of unmapped addresses 0x20 to 0x3C.

rules.quote: ID: CFG-MIN; Parameter values: PARA_NUM_REGS=1, PARA_ADDR_W=7; Purpose: Smallest legal: one register, narrowest address bus
rules.statement: CFG-MIN must be verified with PARA_NUM_REGS=1 and PARA_ADDR_W=7, the smallest legal configuration.

rules.quote: ID: CFG-MAX; Parameter values: PARA_NUM_REGS=16, PARA_ADDR_W=16; Purpose: Largest legal: full register bank, widest address bus, aliasing checks with high address bits
rules.statement: CFG-MAX must be verified with PARA_NUM_REGS=16 and PARA_ADDR_W=16, including aliasing checks with high address bits.

rules.quote: ID: CFG-FULL-A7; Parameter values: PARA_NUM_REGS=16, PARA_ADDR_W=7; Purpose: Full register bank with the narrowest address bus; no unmapped address below 0x44
rules.statement: CFG-FULL-A7 uses PARA_NUM_REGS=16 and PARA_ADDR_W=7, a full register bank with the narrowest address bus and no unmapped address below 0x44.

rules.quote: The verification runs every configuration listed here (run_set.json).
rules.statement: The verification must run every configuration listed in the Configurations table (CFG-BASE, CFG-MIN, CFG-MAX, CFG-FULL-A7), as defined in run_set.json.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-001] On the AW, W and AR channels, the manager shall keep a valid at 1, and its payload stable, from the cycle it rises until the edge of its transfer.
rules.condition: On AW, W and AR channels, once valid rises
rules.statement: The manager shall keep valid at 1 and its payload stable from the cycle it rises until the edge of its transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-002] The manager may keep i_s_axi_bready and i_s_axi_rready at 0 for any number of cycles, may drive them at 1 before the matching valid, and may make them depend on the valid.
rules.statement: The manager may hold i_s_axi_bready and i_s_axi_rready at 0 for any number of cycles, drive them at 1 before the matching valid, and make them depend on the valid.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-003] The environment shall release i_rst_n (0 to 1) synchronously to i_clk, so that the release meets the recovery and removal times of the flip-flops.
rules.statement: The environment shall release i_rst_n synchronously to i_clk so that the release meets recovery and removal times of the flip-flops.

rules.quote: The testbench shall change i_rst_n only away from rising edges of i_clk.
rules.statement: The testbench shall change i_rst_n only away from rising edges of i_clk.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-004] The environment shall drive i_status synchronously to i_clk. The testbench shall change it only away from rising edges.
rules.statement: The environment shall drive i_status synchronously to i_clk, changing it only away from rising edges.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-005] The testbench shall drive defined values (no X or Z) on all inputs while i_rst_n is 1.
rules.statement: The testbench shall drive defined values (no X or Z) on all inputs.

rules.quote: During reset the valids may be 0 or 1.
rules.statement: The valids may be 0 or 1 during reset.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-006] The environment shall drive i_rst_n = 0 from the start of operation (time zero in simulation), before the first rising edge of i_clk, for at least 2 cycles.
rules.statement: The environment shall drive i_rst_n = 0 from time zero, before the first rising edge of i_clk, for at least 2 cycles.

rules.quote: Before the first assertion of i_rst_n the outputs are undefined and no check applies, REQ-VER-010 included (spec-lint GAP-002).
rules.condition: Before the first assertion of i_rst_n
rules.statement: No output check applies, including REQ-VER-010, before the first assertion of i_rst_n, as outputs are undefined.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-007] A reset assertion ends the obligation of REQ-VER-001 for a valid that rose before it: during reset and after R1 the manager may drop that valid or change its payload.
rules.condition: During reset and after R1, for a valid that rose before the reset assertion
rules.statement: A reset assertion ends the REQ-VER-001 obligation; the manager may drop that valid or change its payload.

rules.quote: A valid at 1 after R1 is a new request (REQ-RST-010), with the obligation of REQ-VER-001 from that cycle (spec-lint GAP-005).
rules.statement: A valid at 1 after R1 is a new request and carries the REQ-VER-001 obligation from that cycle.

rules.quote: The values of the registers can be seen directly on o_regs, and also through reads. The held state of the AW, W and AR channels can be seen on o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready.
rules.statement: Register values are observable on o_regs and through reads; held AW, W and AR state is observable on o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready.

rules.quote: A reference model shall predict, at every edge, o_regs and the next value of every handshake output.
rules.statement: A reference model shall predict o_regs and the next value of every handshake output.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-010] The checker shall compare o_regs with the reference model in every cycle, not only after B transfers.
rules.statement: The checker shall compare o_regs with the reference model in every cycle, not only after B transfers.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-011] The checker shall compare o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp only in cycles where o_s_axi_rvalid is 1 or i_rst_n is 0, and o_s_axi_bresp only in cycles where o_s_axi_bvalid is 1 or i_rst_n is 0 (REQ-WR-027, REQ-RD-014, REQ-RST-002).
rules.statement: The checker shall compare o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp only when o_s_axi_rvalid is 1 or i_rst_n is 0, and o_s_axi_bresp only when o_s_axi_bvalid is 1 or i_rst_n is 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-012] A protocol checker shall check that o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid stay 1, with their payload stable, until their transfer, and that no response code is 2'b01 or 2'b11.
rules.statement: A protocol checker shall verify o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid stay 1 with stable payload until transfer, and no response code is 2'b01 or 2'b11.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-020] To check REQ-IF-001, the testbench shall change inputs between rising edges (for example at the falling edge), and shall check that no output changes before the next rising edge.
rules.statement: The testbench shall change inputs between rising edges, e.g. at the falling edge, and check no output changes before the next rising edge.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-021] To check REQ-RST-004, the testbench shall assert i_rst_n between rising edges while transactions are in progress, and shall check the reset values before the next rising edge.
rules.condition: To check REQ-RST-004, transactions in progress
rules.statement: The testbench shall assert i_rst_n between rising edges while transactions are in progress and check reset values before the next rising edge.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-030] Every value of i_s_axi_wstrb (all 16) shall be applied to a write of a mapped register, with data that differs from the old value in every byte.
rules.statement: All 16 values of i_s_axi_wstrb shall be applied, with data differing from the old value in every byte.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-031] Write transactions shall be run with the address before the data (gaps of 1 and of 4 or more cycles), with the data before the address (same gaps), and with both at the same edge.
rules.statement: Writes shall be run with address before data (gaps of 1 and 4+ cycles), data before address (same gaps), and both at the same edge.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-032] The B channel shall be run with i_s_axi_bready delays of 0, 1 and 4 or more cycles, including i_s_axi_bready at 1 before o_s_axi_bvalid rises.
rules.statement: The B channel shall be run with i_s_axi_bready delays of 0, 1 and 4 or more cycles, including i_s_axi_bready at 1 before o_s_axi_bvalid rises.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-033] The R channel shall be run with i_s_axi_rready delays of 0, 1 and 4 or more cycles, including i_s_axi_rready at 1 before o_s_axi_rvalid rises.
rules.statement: The R channel shall be run with i_s_axi_rready delays of 0, 1 and 4 or more cycles, including i_s_axi_rready at 1 before o_s_axi_rvalid rises.

rules.quote: [REQ-VER-034] New AW, W and AR valids shall be presented while a response is held back, to check that they are not taken (REQ-TIM-010, REQ-TIM-011).
rules.condition: While a response is held back
rules.statement: New AW, W and AR valids shall be presented to check they are not taken (REQ-TIM-010, REQ-TIM-011).

rules.quote: ID: D-001; Question: Value of o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready during reset (the description allows 0 or 1); Decision: 0 during reset and in the cycle that ends at R1; 1 from R1 (REQ-RST-001, REQ-RST-006, REQ-RST-007); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19 ID: Q-003; Question: Should the readies be 0 during reset (D-001), or is a cheaper design with readies at 1 during reset wanted?; Decision: Decided: D-001 is final; the readies are 0 during reset and in the cycle that ends at R1; By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.condition: during reset and in the cycle that ends at R1
rules.statement: o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready must be 0 during reset and in the cycle that ends at R1, and 1 from R1.

rules.quote: ID: D-002; Question: Whether readies depend on the valids; Decision: No. The readies are registered and depend only on the held state (REQ-TIM-003, REQ-IF-001); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: The readies must be registered and depend only on the held state, not on the valids.

rules.quote: ID: D-003; Question: Write response latency ("at the earliest one cycle"); Decision: Exactly 1 cycle: bvalid is 1 from Ec (REQ-WR-020); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.condition: write response after the later of the AW and W transfers (Ec)
rules.statement: bvalid must be 1 from Ec, giving a write response latency of exactly 1 cycle.

rules.quote: ID: D-004; Question: Read data latency ("at the earliest one cycle"); Decision: Exactly 1 cycle: rvalid is 1 from Ear (REQ-RD-004); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.condition: read response after the address transfer (Ear)
rules.statement: rvalid must be 1 from Ear, giving a read data latency of exactly 1 cycle.

rules.quote: ID: D-005; Question: Edge at which the register is written; Decision: Ec, the later of the AW and W transfers (REQ-WR-010); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: The register must be written at Ec, the later of the AW and W transfers.

rules.quote: ID: D-006; Question: Old or new value when a read and a write of the same register overlap; Decision: The read samples at Ear. A write at the same edge gives the old value; a write at an earlier Ec gives the new value (REQ-CC-003, REQ-CC-004); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.condition: a read and a write of the same register overlap
rules.statement: The read must sample the register at Ear: a write at the same edge gives the old value, a write at an earlier Ec gives the new value.

rules.quote: ID: D-007; Question: When i_status is sampled; Decision: At Ear, and held until Er (REQ-RD-009, REQ-RD-010); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: i_status must be sampled at Ear and the sampled value held until Er.

rules.quote: ID: D-008; Question: Aliasing of address bits above bit 6; Decision: Full decode of bits [PARA_ADDR_W-1:2]; any 1 above bit 6 is unmapped (REQ-DEC-004, REQ-DEC-005); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: Address bits [PARA_ADDR_W-1:2] must be fully decoded; any 1 above bit 6 makes the address unmapped.

rules.quote: ID: D-009; Question: Values of bresp, rresp and rdata while their valid is 0; Decision: Not specified outside reset and not checked; 0 during reset (REQ-WR-027, REQ-RD-014, REQ-RST-002); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: bresp, rresp and rdata must be 0 during reset; their values while valid is 0 outside reset are not specified or checked.

rules.quote: ID: D-010; Question: When readies return to 1 after a response; Decision: In the cycle after the B or R transfer, with no combinational path from bready or rready (REQ-WR-001, REQ-RD-001); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.condition: after a B or R transfer
rules.statement: The readies must return to 1 in the cycle after the B or R transfer, with no combinational path from bready or rready.

rules.quote: ID: D-011; Question: Illegal parameter values; Decision: The RTL should stop elaboration with an error; not verified (REQ-PAR-003, REQ-PAR-004); By: spec-draft; Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: The RTL should stop elaboration with an error on illegal parameter values.

rules.quote: ID: D-014; Question: Do held states survive a reset; which R1 does "after R1" mean (spec-lint GAP-001); Decision: A reset ends every held state; "after R1" is the most recent R1 (section 2 terms); By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: A reset must end every held state; "after R1" means the most recent R1.

rules.quote: ID: D-015; Question: Inputs, outputs and checks before the first reset (spec-lint GAP-002); Decision: Reset from time zero for at least 2 cycles; outputs undefined and unchecked before it: REQ-VER-006; By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: Reset must be applied from time zero for at least 2 cycles; outputs are undefined and unchecked before the first reset.

rules.quote: ID: D-018; Question: Valid and payload of a request across a reset (spec-lint GAP-005); Decision: Reset ends the obligation; a valid after R1 is a new request: REQ-VER-007; By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.condition: request in progress across a reset
rules.statement: Reset ends the obligation on a pending request; a valid after R1 must be treated as a new request.

The block has one clock, i_clk, which defines the clock domain CLK.
The target frequency is 50 MHz.
Every input, including i_status, is synchronous to i_clk.
The block has no clock-domain crossing and contains no synchronizer.
i_rst_n is active low.
Release is synchronous to i_clk, and the environment guarantees this (see section 12).
The only order defined between reads and writes is the one given in section 7.6.
No area budget is given.
